# --default-symver does not work with lto, which fuzz introspector uses.
if [ "$SANITIZER" == "introspector" ]; then
  sed -i 's/--default-symver/-flto/g' ./configure.ac
fi
# Run the OSS-Fuzz script in the project.
./test/ossfuzz/ossfuzz.sh

dependency_reason: json_loadb initializes the lexer and delegates parsing.
parse_json delegates value acceptance to parse_value.
The 'o' branch assigns the existing root without incrementing its reference count.
Each json_unpack call delegates to json_vunpack_ex.
json_vunpack_ex initializes scanning and invokes unpack.
Object-field lookup passes the field and key to unpack.
The keyed message is constructed only in boolean dispatch.
json_unpack passes a null error pointer.
The added check obtains diagnostic text through json_unpack_ex.
